content.systemBoundary: A greenhouse sensing node that periodically measures temperature, humidity, soil moisture, and light, attaches timestamps to measurements, stores an analysis-ready log, and supports remote reporting while keeping deployment, accuracy, sampling/reporting cadence, and communication/power constraints as open questions until confirmed.

nodes.name: Deployment & Session Configuration Input
responsibilities: Accept greenhouse deployment context (indoor vs outdoor exposure) and session intent.
Provide placeholders for unknown deployment environment, measurement accuracy, sampling/reporting cadence, and remote communication/power constraints.
Represent unknown maintenance-related operational constraints as non-blocking placeholders where needed.

nodes.name: Environmental Measurement Acquisition
responsibilities: Measure temperature and humidity for greenhouse monitoring.
Measure light for greenhouse monitoring.
Emit measurement samples with timestamps for later storage and reporting.

nodes.name: Soil Moisture Measurement Acquisition
responsibilities: Measure soil moisture for greenhouse monitoring.
Emit soil-moisture measurement samples with timestamps for later storage and reporting.

nodes.name: Timestamped Measurement Storage
responsibilities: Buffer and persist periodic timestamped measurement records.
Support storage/log sizing based on sampling and reporting interval targets (unknown in this phase).
Provide stored records to analysis and remote reporting steps.

nodes.name: Greenhouse Measurement Analysis & Summaries
responsibilities: Aggregate stored records into analysis-ready greenhouse monitoring summaries.
Highlight gaps between assumed and confirmed measurement accuracy requirements.
Prepare data structures suitable for remote reporting of readings.

nodes.name: Remote Readings Reporting
responsibilities: Transmit greenhouse readings to a remote consumer for monitoring.
Represent unknown communication constraints that affect reporting feasibility without committing to a specific protocol.
Include references to open constraints influencing interpretation.

nodes.name: Power & Long-Duration Operation Management
responsibilities: Coordinate long-duration operation with unknown power-source constraints.
Provide placeholders for power budgeting behavior that depends on sampling/reporting cadence.
Support safe shutdown or maintenance coordination without specifying physical power hardware.

edges.description: Deployment/session constraints are applied to how acquisition and reporting behave while unknown targets remain placeholders.
Sampling cadence and unknown storage-sizing constraints control how periodic measurement logs are buffered and stored.
Environmental samples are routed into timestamped storage.
Soil-moisture samples are routed into timestamped storage.
Stored measurement logs are aggregated into greenhouse monitoring summaries and analysis-ready outputs.
Analysis-ready readings are routed to remote reporting while communication constraints remain unconfirmed.
Power management behavior influences the ability to buffer and persist measurement records during long-duration sessions.

assumptions.statement: A functional architecture can represent unknown deployment exposure, communication/power feasibility, and accuracy/cadence requirements as open questions without committing to specific components.
